テキスト cha 650: Born Shiyo 750, February 4. Height 172cm (as of Shiyo 800). From the Arata settlement; the Shirozaki family is an old line, like the Niimura family.
He calls danger sense 'the witch's power' and warns Natsumi Kogori not to tell anyone in the settlement about it. According to him, 'the witch's power' is something shunned in the settlement.

He takes Natsumi Kogori to the convenience store at the mountain's foot and helps her danger sense work. On the way back he speaks of 'the witch's oracle,' and she is told that killing those with danger sense is the very aim of the settlement. Natsumi Kogori sees this as a danger and holds a knife to him, but he admonishes her that this is what the curse-killings truly are. In other words, it was a lie to let Natsumi Kogori, too, feel firsthand the state of mind in which suspicion feeding on itself leaves no one in the settlement able to trust anyone. However, how far his words were a lie remains unknown.

He delivers a single cherry branch to Erika Niimura. He entrusted it, he says, so it could be used to foresee danger, hoping for an end to the curse-killings. This act can be called a sign of his trust in Natsumi Kogori, and having lost his wife in the first curse-killing, he longs more than anyone for the curse-killings to be solved.

As the only resident outside the Niimura family who did not take part in the attack on Natsumi Kogori and the others, he was not arrested and still lives in the Arata settlement. He promises Erina Goto and the others to answer what puzzles them about the curse-killings, and goes home.

He calls out to Erina Goto, who is hiding alone in the settlement, and walks her back to the Niimura house. Until then Erina believes the residents attacked Chigaya Niimura, but his utterly ordinary behavior convinces her that the group that attacked Chigaya was not the residents but corpses put to work by Shigatsu Youka.
